items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: I see George Lewis, I see Bill Robichaud, the whole smear from the Mardi Gras Lounge

ctx.x: I had a son incidentally, a pilot in the Air Force was stationed at Tachikawa near Japan. And who do you think, he walked in the officers club and they came back and they brought me all kinds of things. And who do you think, including some programs, he walks in the officers club and he says, who do I see in there? I see George Lewis, I see Bill Robichaud, the whole smear from the Mardi Gras Lounge, you know, in here. He was, George was out there for him. Yeah.
He had his big success of him, about three years, three success of him, tours. Oh, they loved him. They loved him. They loved him.
